name: Eleanor Ainsworth
bio:
Eleanor Ainsworth brings a wealth of culinary and management experience to the high-octane world of motorsport. Starting her career in fine dining, she quickly realized her organizational skills and passion for perfection could be applied in a more dynamic environment. A chance encounter with a team owner led her to motorsport, where she found the fast-paced atmosphere and the need for impeccable service incredibly stimulating. 

Eleanor's approach is all about providing top-tier catering that fuels both body and mind. She believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and she meticulously plans menus to cater to diverse dietary needs while maintaining the highest standards of quality and taste. Her relentless pursuit of excellence ensures that every meal is an experience, contributing to the overall morale and performance of the team.

What sets Eleanor apart is her visionary approach to motorsport catering. She is constantly innovating, exploring new culinary techniques and ingredients to elevate the dining experience and keep the team energized and focused. Her dedication to detail and her ability to anticipate needs make her an invaluable asset to any racing organization.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, layered with a side fringe
physical.description: Eleanor is a slender woman with a warm smile and a perpetually busy demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Keeps a detailed spreadsheet of every team member's dietary preferences and allergies.
Always has a stash of gourmet teas and artisanal biscuits on hand.
